text.p: Mercedes completed a 1-2 finish in the sixth round of the world sportscar championship at the A1-ring on Sunday but could not dislodge McLaren-BMW drivers from top of the overall standings.
The all-German trio of Klaus Ludwig, Bernd Maylander and Bernd Schneider won the 160-lap race ahead of Italian Alessandro Nannini and his German co-driver Marcel Tiemann.
McLaren BMW drivers J.J.Lehto of Finland and Briton Steve Soper finished third and continue to share the overall championship lead on 42 points. Schneider is third on 32 -- 10 ahead of Ludwig.
Schneider also drove the fourth-placed Mercedes, partnering Austrian Alexander Wurz.
BMW lead the team championship with 58 points, nine ahead of Mercedes.
